statement: Community notes describe Joy-Con simple input 0x3F as two button bytes, a hat byte and eight filler bytes; it is reported for button state changes rather than a fixed measured 0x30-like cadence.

applicability.scope: Source-described 0x3F Joy-Con variant only; no retail packet, no proven filler invariants across revisions.
